lineage_findings.finding: SoFiUSD is the product name and SOFID is the official ticker; these are aliases for one candidate, not two assets.
USA₮ is a distinct Anchorage-issued product created in collaboration with Tether and is not the same asset as Tether USD₮.
EUB and USB share an issuer and program but are distinct crypto-assets with different reference currencies.
The account-limited JPYSC issuance and planned public-chain JPYSC are one announced lineage, not separate candidates.
Hazel Network is presently an infrastructure and dual-character token design without a final independently named canonical stablecoin identity.
